meta.description: Triage and resolve Arch Linux issues with pacman, systemd, and rolling-release best practices.

copy.tagline: 排查并修复 Arch Linux 系统问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Arch Linux 并常遇到系统问题
copy.tagline_en: Triage and fix Arch Linux system issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Arch Linux and often encounter system issues

howto.what: 装后，Claude会变成Arch Linux专家，帮你诊断和解决系统问题（如pacman、systemd、内核更新等），提供一步步的排查步骤、修复命令和回滚方法。
howto.when: 当你提出Arch Linux相关的技术问题，尤其是涉及软件包管理、系统服务或滚动更新后的故障时触发。

say.text: 我更新后无法启动系统，怎么办？
say.note: Claude会分析日志并提供修复命令。

say.text: pacman提示文件冲突，如何解决？
say.note: Claude会给出处理冲突的步骤。

say.text: 如何安全回滚最近的内核更新？
say.note: Claude会提供回滚方案和验证命令。

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude becomes an Arch Linux expert, helping you diagnose and resolve system issues (e.g., pacman, systemd, kernel updates) by providing step-by-step triage, remediation commands, and rollback steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Arch Linux technical issues, especially those involving package management, system services, or problems after rolling updates.

say_en.text: I can't boot after an update, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze logs and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: pacman reports file conflicts, how to resolve?
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to handle conflicts.

say_en.text: How to safely rollback the recent kernel update?
say_en.note: Claude will offer rollback steps and validation.
